topic: Neural Network Learning: The Intuition of Backpropagation

sections.title: The Learning Goal (The 'Guessing' Game)
lecture_lines: Neural networks are just functions learning to approximate outputs.
The network makes a guess: 'Is this a cat?'
The ground truth says: 'Yes, it is.'
We calculate the error: prediction minus target truth.
Our goal: minimize this error signal.
animations: Show a neural network icon labeled 'NN' and a target label 'Truth'.
Display MathTex: 'Loss = |Prediction - Truth|' in #FFFFFF color.
Animate a prediction '0.7' (Cat) approaching '1.0' (Truth).
Highlight the difference '0.3' in #FF4500 (Red) as 'Error'.
Fade out elements to signify the end of the concept.

sections.title: The Prerequisite: The Weight 'Knobs'
lecture_lines: Weights are like adjustable knobs on a machine.
Each knob changes the final system output.
Learning is tuning these knobs for perfection.
animations: Show a neural network connection as a knob labeled 'Weight'.
Animate a user hand turning the knob back and forth.
Display MathTex: 'Output = Input * Weight' in #00FFFF (Cyan).
Show the 'Loss' value fluctuating as the weight changes.
Fade in a cluster of knobs representing multiple weights.

sections.title: The Logic of Backpropagation
lecture_lines: Backpropagation is assigning blame for errors.
Traverse backward from output to the input layers.
Each weight is adjusted by its contribution to error.
Managers blame leads, leads blame individual developers.
Everyone learns from their specific mistakes.
animations: Show a multi-layer network with error flowing backwards.
Highlight weights in #FFD700 (Gold) as they are blamed.
Display MathTex: 'Gradient = ∂Error/∂Weight' in #FFD700.
Animate small pulses traveling from output to input.
Update the weight value to reduce the error.

sections.title: Visualizing Gradient Descent
lecture_lines: The loss landscape is a hilly terrain.
The current error is your altitude.
We take steps downhill to minimize error.
This path is known as gradient descent.
A hiker finds the valley of minimum error.
animations: Render a 2D surface plot (landscape) in #4682B4 (SteelBlue).
Place a 'Network' ball on top of a hill.
Draw a line showing the steep descent path.
Display MathTex: 'w_new = w_old - η * ∇Loss' in #FFFFFF.
Animate the ball rolling towards the valley.

sections.title: Conclusion: The Iterative Loop
lecture_lines: Predict, check, adjust, and repeat the cycle.
Thousands of iterations build an expert network.
Learning is a repetitive practice of refinement.
animations: Display a circular cycle diagram with four phases.
Highlight 'Forward' phase, then 'Loss' calculation.
Highlight 'Backward' phase, then 'Weight Update' phase.
Repeat the loop animation to show continuous training.
Fade in text: 'Practice makes perfect!' in #00FF00 (Lime).
